description: No key needed for a token from a preview made without a key: then it shows the watermarked preview image and palette only (read-only). Other tokens need an API key. Shows a converted image as it is now, for editing with edit_vector: its palette (colours, their share and labels), its revision (rev) and edit log, and a watermarked preview image. Free and changes nothing. Pass x and y, a pixel of that preview image, to get the region there: its key (region.region) for region edits, colour, size and neighbours. Over a transparent pixel region is null.

inline_max_bytes.description: Largest preview image, in bytes, to include (default 1048576). 0 leaves the image out.

x.description: Pixel column in the preview image (0 is the left edge).

y.description: Pixel row in the preview image (0 is the top edge).

name: inspect_vector

palette.description: The colours of the edited result, largest share first. labels are the keys mergeColours and splitColour take.

preview.description: The preview image: its size in pixels, and preview pixels per source pixel.

region.description: The region under (x, y): region (the key for region edits), color, area and bbox (source pixels), neighbours (longest shared edge first) and outline (an SVG path in preview pixels). null over transparency.

rev.description: The revision to send to edit_vector.

stale.description: Edits in the log that no longer apply (index into edits, and why). They stay in the log.

title: Inspect a vector for editing
